achievements.name: Dress for Success

achievements.description: Killed 25 enemies with the Broadsider Pistol.

achievements.description: Looted 200 containers.

achievements.description: Killed a Handyman by only shooting his heart.

achievements.description: Opened 30 Tears.

achievements.description: Fully upgraded one weapon and one Vigor.

achievements.name: Hazard Pay
achievements.description: Killed 10 enemies by utilizing environmental hazards.

achievements.description: Killed 75 enemies either with a Vigor or while the enemy is under the effects of a Vigor.

achievements.description: Lured 3 enemies into a single Vigor trap 5 times.

achievements.description: Used Elizabeth to pick 30 locks.

achievements.description: In CitC, knocked an enemy off the city with Undertow, then rescued him, then knocked him off again.
